correctness.rationale: The leaf event for label \(i\) has probability \((i-1)/(n-1)\). For \(j>i\), deleting the forbidden parent-choice factor gives \(\operatorname{Cov}(A_j,Y_i)=(i-1)/[(n-1)(j-1)(j-2)]\); for \(j\le i\) independence gives zero. Summing over \(j\) telescopes to the labeled-leaf formula; summing over \(i<j\) gives exactly \(1/[2(n-1)]\) for every \(j\ge3\), and summing over arrivals gives the global covariance. The root-degree variance follows from independent Bernoulli attachments; the leaf variance follows from the exact one-step leaf recursion. A fresh independent enumeration of all parent sequences through \(n=7\) reproduced the global and equal-share covariances exactly; the infinite/family claim rests on the analytic calculation, not enumeration.
